source_note: Mined from Proveana (German Lost Art Foundation, proveana.de — colonial-contexts person/corporate-body index) and PAESE (postcolonial-provenance-research.com — database + subproject pages). Entries marked why_flag_basis='index' are derived from the registry's occupation/context tags (Kolonialdienst, Militär, Sammeltätigkeit, Handel mit Ethnografica, Human Remains, colony tags); per-entry Proveana URLs follow the site's person-slug pattern and were spot-verified by the mining agent. Entries duplicated in episodes_german.json are kept slim here and enriched at merge.

actors.name: Kurt Strümpell
actors.why_flag: PAESE documents him as a Schutztruppe officer 1900-1912 'involved in numerous violent military interventions against the local population' who gave ~700 objects to Städtisches Museum Braunschweig 1901-1908; collection classified historically sensitive — any Strümpell provenance warrants acquisition-context review.
